tokens.usage: PhaseRing: the grain that falls into the current phase.

tokens.name: button-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary (glass) button fill before the topic tint (8% of k). fg on it 16:1.

tokens.name: button-off
tokens.usage: Disabled button fill. Its label button-off-ink is 2.7:1: disabled controls are exempt, never use it for live text.

tokens.name: button-off-ink
tokens.usage: Disabled button label on button-off.

tokens.name: word-frozen

tokens.name: word-autumn

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Count badge on the orb and on tabs (new messages, notifications): magenta from her ring, never red (red is destructive only). Always with a 2px ring in bg round it.

tokens.name: badge-ink
tokens.usage: Digits on badge: bold 11px, 4.7:1 on #c026d3.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: The assistant that actually does it
styles.usage: Big headline on a hero or post.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The assistant listens and talks through this iPhone.

styles.name: sub
styles.usage: The dim line under a title.

styles.name: anchor
styles.usage: The one handwritten anchor per screen (Anchor): topic colour, -3 degrees, opacity .9. Caveat from Google Fonts, Bradley Hand on Apple devices.

styles.name: widget-value
styles.usage: The big number of a wide or large widget (46px in small and tall).

styles.name: widget-label
styles.usage: Widget label, caps, in the topic colour.

tokens.name: pad-card
tokens.usage: Padding inside a card.

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Between cards on a page.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page side margin.

tokens.name: air-max
tokens.usage: Most air between parts of a screen. Rest is shared evenly over hero, block and her line, at most 16px extra per gap.

tokens.name: anchor-reach
tokens.usage: The handwritten anchor sits within this distance of its subject.

tokens.name: anchor-clear
tokens.usage: Minimum free space between the anchor and any line or label.

tokens.name: widget-pad
tokens.usage: Padding inside a widget.

tokens.name: widget-small
tokens.usage: Widget unit: small is 170 x 170, tall is 170 wide.

tokens.name: widget-wide
tokens.usage: Width of wide and large widgets (two units plus a 20px gap).

tokens.name: widget-tall
tokens.usage: Height of tall and large widgets.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: PageDots: a dot, and the height of the active streak.

tokens.name: dot-active
tokens.usage: PageDots: width of the active streak.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Every card, row and sheet.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Large full-width buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, tabs, small buttons, toggles.

tokens.name: radius-widget
tokens.usage: Every widget.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The frosted list panel inside a glass or pattern widget.

tokens.name: radius-bleed
tokens.usage: Bottom corners of the one widget per three screens that breaks to the edge.

tokens.usage: The hairline of a secondary (glass) button. Primary has none.

tokens.usage: Pen spotlight: dims everything around the marked row inside its card.
